description: VaMRT - a real-time AI-driven NPC: NVIDIA ARDY generates her motion live from Voxta's conversation; Senses tells the AI about the room, Face drives expression and gaze from her mood. Prototype - see the GitHub repo for the PC side and the install guide.
credits: BVH Player: a modified build (v5.9: streaming chunks, root re-basing, floor cap) of ElkVR / VRAdultFun's BVH Player 1.1.3 (CC BY). Motion model: NVIDIA ARDY (code Apache-2.0, weights under the NVIDIA Open Model Agreement). ardy2bvh converter: iremoztrk (Apache-2.0). Expressions used by the Face plugin: AshAuryn, ascorad (Hub). Thanks to AcidBubbles (Voxta, Timeline) and FutureStorm (VoxtaTouchElite).
instructions: 1) Install this var. 2) PC side: get the VaMRT repo from github.com/therre559/vam-rt, run pc\setup.bat. 3) Voxta: import voxta\scenario mood v43.json from the repo. 4) Load Saves/scene/VaMRT/VaMRT Demo.json, pick your Voxta character, apply any look. Full guide: docs/INSTALL.md in the repo.
